listing.name: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: My Life as a King (darkuni Recomp)
listing.summary: Player-managed My Life as a King setup using its own WiiWare WAD.
listing.original_game_title: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: My Life as a King

steps.title: Prepare the WiiWare originals
steps.instruction: For an already permitted Windows x64 copy, keep the runtime and its DLLs together in a writable folder. Put your own NTSC-U My Life as a King base WAD (WFCE) there. Add the matching optional DLC WAD only if you have it.

steps.title: Let the upstream player import the WADs
steps.instruction: Run mylifeking.exe from the upstream folder. The first launch populates game and, with matching DLC, game/dlc. Keep both original WADs separately from the generated files.

steps.title: Preserve the upstream profile
steps.instruction: Keep nand, mylifeking.ini, the generated game folder and the creating runtime together.

warnings: Use an already permitted copy. The published license for the upstream project has its own scope, and the package contains translated title code. Fresh acquisition needs attributable permission for that code or a separately reviewed preparation route.
Keep the upstream folder outside the Portcove library. Close the game and its helpers before backing up or replacing the creating runtime and its data.

listing.download_block_reason: Fresh Portcove downloads are held because the selected Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: My Life as a King executable contains translated title code and the published project license does not establish permission for that separate component. Resume with an attributable applicable grant or a reviewed package or preparation route that resolves it. Independently permitted copies retain their own setup route.
